changes.title: Worms eye potion
items: Worm's Eye potions bring the camera almost to ground level. Adjust the angle and distance in the Potion lab.

changes.title: Settings open cancel
items: Settings stays closed when you resume before its first load finishes.

changes.title: Pause native keys
items: Keys pressed while paused no longer press buttons behind the pause screen.

changes.title: Mushroom brewing
items: Find mushrooms in quiet corners of the forest and bring them home to the kitchen baskets.
Throw three mushrooms into the cauldron to brew a potion, disappear into colourful smoke and wake beneath the kitchen.
Potions last ten minutes of game time, fading over the last two minutes. During development, the blackout names the effect and marks unfinished ones Coming soon.
Open Potion lab from the pause page to browse numbered recipes, try effects, adjust their settings and copy them for a trip report.

changes.title: Miniature potion
items: Miniature makes the island look like a toy world, with thin little-speaker sound.
Potions now alter existing sounds throughout the trip, fading back to normal as they wear off.

changes.title: Chunky potion
items: Chunky potions turn the world into much bigger pixels. Adjust their size in the Potion lab.

changes.title: Audience potion
items: The Audience potion makes the forest lean towards you and follow your passage, a little late.

changes.title: Water only lakes
items: Islands prepare ground effects for just their own kinds of lake, keeping the same look.

changes.title: Travel path prep
items: Island paths and ground heights can be prepared while you sail.

changes.title: Travel ground extras
items: Ground preparation leaves out details absent from the island.

changes.title: Slow frame log
items: Slow-frame logs include loading state and measured update/drawing sections, grouped into short summaries during a bad stretch.

changes.title: Sigil cache
items: Creature sigils reuse their prepared shapes when drawn again.

changes.title: Shader landing limit
items: Slow-loading islands can open with simple ground and marked lakes while their finer details finish.

changes.title: Pause pad back
items: The pad's Back on the pause page is no longer missed when you press it just after pausing on a slow frame

changes.title: Pause input stack
items: Keys held while pausing no longer carry into play when you resume.
The pause menu recognises Back reliably when reopened between frames.

changes.title: Online prototype
items: A separate two-player prototype page is available for local connection tests.

changes.title: Mushroom generator
items: A mushroom art preview now grows colourful, glowing, individually shaped mushrooms beside the witch for scale.
Adjust mushroom height, cap pointiness and other shape ranges; coloured glowing spots stay apart and clear of the cap edge.

changes.title: Magic polish
items: Magic beams have broader, brighter cores, and shadow magic is easier to see.

changes.title: Lazy update notes
items: Settings has a What's new tab. It loads a few recent versions when opened, with Load more for older notes.

changes.title: Layered magic
items: Magic has layered flames, ice, water, petals and other elemental effects, with capped light and temporary marks on the forest.
The party spell rises in a pillar, runestone casts swirl, and frost briefly coats nearby trees.

changes.title: Late house landing
items: On slow journeys your witch lands asleep and wakes to her alarm when the treehouse is ready.

changes.title: Direct play
items: Games that skip dressing up start playing when ready, without a start card. Update notes no longer load at startup.

changes.title: Compressed logs
items: Saved playtest comments and JSON logs use lossless input runs and compression when available. Builders can still restore older JSON logs, and oversized or damaged files report an error.

changes.title: Cauldron live
items: Mushrooms grow by the dancefloor at home. Walk over them to pick them up; in the kitchen they hop into the baskets, E at a basket throws one into the cauldron, and three make a brew.

changes.title: Trunk band
items: Pine trunks no longer have a pale orange band where they go up into the leaves

changes.title: Travel logs
items: Travel logs give more detail about loading pauses.

changes.title: Stumps grounded
items: The great stumps lie on the ground at every camera angle, no longer floating as you zoom or fly
The music spell sits right in the middle of the stump's rings, and the soundsystem stands there too
The spell's analyser lies flat round the rings and fills the whole root area, its bars starting outside the music notes
When a wave brings the party to an area, its stump's analyser bursts out from the centre all at once as the soundsystem rises
A key hint (E, hold) by the music notes when you can cast

changes.title: Stump wisps
items: A wild stump's clearing is lit by eerie teal moonlight and a few blue, green and teal wisps drifting round it, not by its sigils' red glow; away from the party her own glow turns cool too, so the wild reads blue-green and the party warm

changes.title: Stump polish
items: You can cast the soundsystem spell anywhere on a stump's cut top, not just its middle; the 🎶 and its hold prompt show when you're on it
Stumps grow more irregular: wobblier cuts, notches, off-centre hearts and uneven rings
Far-off stump wisps are small soft glows that fade with distance, not big squares
The spell's rainbow analyser is an even circle round the stump, no longer longer at the bottom

changes.title: Stump keep clear
items: Nothing special stands right by a stump or runestone any more: legend circles, giant mushrooms, ruins, walls, flasks, finds, ponds, campfires, picnics and playgrounds all keep 40 m away

changes.title: Storage fallback
items: Broom parts, record choices and settings stay available while playing if browser storage refuses to save them.

changes.title: Stack log
items: The playtest log (L) now records your sigil stack, so a stuck sigil can be traced

changes.title: Sigil design pass
items: Polar bear, unicorn, beaver, wolf and squirrel sigils use clearer, simpler shapes.

changes.title: Shake and range
items: Screen shake from a hit stops after a moment, even in a legend's circle or on the treehouse deck, and a flurry of hits can't keep it going
Creatures' shots at you no longer fizzle out before they reach you: they fly as far as they're fired from

changes.title: Screen support
items: Settings only offers screen selection in browsers that support it.

changes.title: Scenery frame stalls
items: Scenery updates stay spread over frames when play slows down.

changes.title: Save resume night
items: Your night is saved as you play. Return to the same version to resume where you left off.
Resuming takes you straight back into play. A new night is saved once you're out of bed.

changes.title: Sail height slices
items: The terrain is prepared in short steps before the flight from the sea chart.
The sea chart keeps moving while the next island finishes loading.

changes.title: Rainbow wave
items: Clearing an area before its wave sends a rainbow wave down the ley line, music bars dancing along it, showing the way ahead as it passes: follow it to scout the route

changes.title: Quick win pulse
items: After a quick win the victory lap's pulse runs the whole ley line home, round the dancefloor's ring to the treehouse, rather than stopping at the top of the ring
The ley line's dots no longer show through the ground past the horizon's bend or behind a hill

changes.title: Quality recover
items: Auto quality climbs back up once there's room again, so a slow patch no longer leaves the canopy's soft fade round the witch off for the rest of the night

changes.title: Pins breathe
items: The morning's guide pins gently pulse until you cast the party spell

changes.title: Orbit tighter
items: The ❤️, 💧 and 💌 rings sit closer round the animals, and a soundsystem's 💥s closer round it

changes.title: Multiplayer groundwork
items: Multiplayer groundwork: the rules can step several witches independently, sharing the night clock and pausing only when everyone pauses. Online play is still to come.

changes.title: Morning order
items: On your first morning the pins lead you round in order: the dressing table, wardrobe, shoes, bag, invitations, cloak, hat, then your broom

changes.title: Menu recovery
items: Settings keeps at least one Choose and Back binding on each device, so clearing or swapping controls can't leave you stuck in a menu.

changes.title: Leyline boot dots
items: The ley line is drawn as its rainbow dots as soon as its tip comes off the home ring, not only once the boot is over
The boot's line round the home ring is drawn like the rest of the ley line: rainbow dots ahead of its pulse, the music's analyser behind it, and the same spark
The boot's ring and the ley line are one line: after its lap round the dancefloor the line carries on round the same way and sweeps off toward the first runestone, never doubling back the other way

changes.title: Letter impact
items: An animal you win over celebrates for a second, its own way: hoppers jump and spin, four-legged ones roll over, flyers loop the loop and the rest do a wiggle-dance, with a burst of hearts, and its sigil above the runestone turns to your colour with a pop

A 💌 landing on an animal now lands with a punch: a white flash, a little squash, its ring slot popping in and a soft thunk that rises as the ring fills; the 💌 that fills the ring holds the picture for an instant
With Reduce flashing on there is no white flash and the squash is gentler

changes.title: Input presses
items: T toggles auto-talk again, and remapped mouse buttons can toggle talking.
Hat presses count once on fast and slow displays.
Right and middle mouse bindings keep working while held, including invitations and using objects.

changes.title: Hat storage fallback
items: Newly found hats remain available while playing if browser storage refuses to save them.

changes.title: Hat band capes
items: Her hats lie on the Cloakroom floor: walk up to one and press E to wear it, leaving the one she had on in its place
A new Band card at the mirror: one colour for the hat's glowing band and its plume
Short cloaks go down to the knee, long cloaks from the knee down
Cloak and scarf lengths are on their own cards
The cloak pegs stand in the Cloakroom's north-east corner, and last night's clothes lie in the middle of the bedroom

changes.title: Gamepad pause
items: The pause page and its Controls, What's new and Options panels can be navigated with a gamepad. Choose and Back follow your bindings; Settings keeps its fixed recovery controls, and Start always reaches pause.

changes.title: Gamepad hints
items: The sea chart and telescope show controls for the device you're using, including remapped gamepad buttons. Moving the mouse brings keyboard and mouse prompts back.

changes.title: Gamepad foundation
items: Remapped gamepad buttons can now talk, toggle auto-talk and use every playtest action.
Gamepads can give short feedback for hits, knockdowns, landings, waves and the night's outcome. Gamepad rumble can be turned off in Accessibility; Reduce flashing turns it off too.

changes.title: Default look
items: Pause page (with the debug overlay or Unlock everything on): Copy look as defaults gives how she's dressed now as the game's default look, and Try as a new witch opens a tab playing as a brand-new witch, nothing saved

changes.title: Stun worth
items: A happy legend mends the 💧s on it again, little by little

changes.title: Pins everywhere
items: The guide pin stays with you when you leave the treehouse, and stays over the thing it points at when you get there

changes.title: Orbit combat
items: ❤️s and 💌s now fade together, one at a time from the newest, and more slowly: a full ring takes about 50 seconds to empty, not 33

No more health bars: your animals' blows fill a creature's 💌 ring with ❤️s, and once it's full it's stunned; one more 💌 and it's yours. Your own animals take 💧s from enemy blows instead; one berry washes them all away, and if they fill up the animal runs off for good
Soundsystems show their health as a ring of 💥s, and anything running away for good wears a big 💧

changes.title: Nobody vanishes
items: Nobody vanishes in a night: a party animal knocked down, and the happy babies of a soundsystem you lose, run to the beach and sleep there too

changes.title: Legend attacks
items: Awake legends throw their kind's attack across the forest: a huge slow bomb you can see coming for seconds, bursting into a bigger, wilder version of their kind's attack. Happy legends' bombs chase down the enraged for you

changes.title: Tree cap sliders
items: Pause-page sliders for the tallest trees' height (Tree height cap): how much of a tree over the cap it keeps, and where the cap starts

changes.title: No wake tip
items: No more tip at the bottom of the screen once you're up: getting dressed and finding your decks are left to you

changes.title: Conga follows
items: When the night's won, the conga line follows you while you're on the ground in the home area, filing after you wherever you walk; fly up or go into the treehouse and it goes back round the dancefloor

changes.title: Workshop furniture
items: The Workshop has its furniture: the broom bay (trestles, a creeper, a red tool chest), the lathe bench with its paint tins, and the pegboard redrawn as the 3 × 3 biome board, each cell framed in its biome's colour under a compass rose

changes.title: Studio instruments
items: The Studio's instruments are drawn: a glam-rock drum kit in pink glitter with a neon star on its kick, a retro wall of synths with blinking lights and tangled cables, and the microphone under its spot lamp

changes.title: Station fixes
items: At the wardrobe, dressing table, shoe rack and the other stations, the camera now frames you whole, on the part you're choosing (your head, your top, your shoes), instead of aiming at your feet with your head off screen; zooming in first no longer pushes it closer still

On a gamepad at a station, the bottom face button chooses (it used to fly you off), the d-pad or the right stick moves through the menu, and only the left stick walks you; on a keyboard, Enter, E or Space chooses
Landing on an item you own still puts it on straight away; choosing one you haven't found yet says so
A look you chose at the dressing table no longer gets swapped back for an older one if you changed your mind quickly

changes.title: Packs volcanic
items: Komodo dragons, salamanders and stegosauruses fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs temperate
items: Beavers and stags fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs mountains
items: Frost wyrms, lynxes, red pandas and snow leopards fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs mangrove
items: Crabs, dragonflies and hydras fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs jungle
items: Elephants, jaguars, jungle pythons and tigers fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs hot
items: Sand cats, cheetahs, fennecs and lions fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs cold
items: Arctic foxes, elk, frost trolls, penguins and polar bears fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs cold rainforest
items: Black bears, flying squirrels and roe deer fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Packs badlands
items: Armadillos, meerkats, rattlesnakes and scorpions fight as packs now: they take turns, combo their moves and fall back between attacks

changes.title: Mic spotlight
items: The Studio's microphone stands in a cone of warm light from its spot lamp

changes.title: Making of coordinator
items: The Making Of: the coordinator's own account of how the game is built, and a note that the balance pass is paused while the game's systems settle

changes.title: House furniture all
items: Every piece of furniture in the treehouse is drawn now, twice as big as before: the bed, the clothes rail, the vanity, the window's curtains (shut while you wake), the cloak pegs, the shoe rack, the crystal ball, the telephone, the hat mirror and rug, the bags, the invitations desk, the broom stand, the pegboard, the record shelf, the cauldron, the tea table, the card table, the bestiary's book and its skulls, the telescope, the map table and the locked bedrooms' doors
Furniture along the walls follows the round rooms' curves, and the tables, the cauldron and the crystal ball stand out in the room

changes.title: House decor
items: The treehouse's rooms are dressed: rugs, lamps, candles, lanterns, plants, books, glowing mushrooms, little neon signs and shelves strung with fairy lights, each room its own colours, kept out of your way and clear of everything you use

changes.title: Boot art first
items: The first picture is ready sooner: the trees and creatures on screen are drawn first, the rest of the island after

changes.title: Starfield
items: A new night sky: many faint stars and a few bright ones in their own colours, the Milky Way across it, and the odd nebula
The telescope tilts up and down (▲ ▼) to look at the stars; zoom is now the mouse wheel, Z and X, or the gamepad's shoulder buttons
Tonight's find is written in the stars: look through the telescope the way it lies and you'll see its shape as a constellation; hold the view on it to see the lines
The crystal ball is clouded for now: it no longer shows the find

changes.title: Map in worker
items: Sailing to an island lands sooner: the island is made while the chart flies you there

changes.title: Hazel tall
items: The hazel forest no longer has mushroom-shaped trees: a tall hazel, grown up from a coppice in a few slim stems, takes their place

changes.title: Envelope occlusion
items: 💌s and the invite rings are hidden behind trees, rocks and scenery the way animals are, and smoke veils them

changes.title: Stegosaurus head
items: The stegosaurus's head is smaller, lower and beaked on a longer neck, so it no longer looks like a bear
The stegosaurus elder's lava-veined plates stand apart instead of merging into one dark mass

changes.title: Snow leopard
items: A new kind of area for the high glaciers' island, the icefall: glacier ice and old snow, cairns and leaning standing stones, stunted pines, rowan and dwarf birch in the lee of the rocks

The snow leopard, a new creature for it: a long, low, pale smoky cat with an enormously long, thick ringed tail, that leaps on you from afar; its legend is the elder of the snow leopards, its long ringed tail worn round its shoulders like a stole, and its gift is Ghost of the peaks (a longer blink, and sharper turns in the treetops)

changes.title: Sigil by size
items: A happy animal's sigil lies just below its feet, whatever its size: a mouse's close, an elephant's further off, so you always see the whole sigil (and a parked animal rests the same way above its own)
Sigils on the ground can be picked up from a quarter further away

changes.title: Sentry range
items: The Sentry hat throws its 💌s as far as the witch does (33 m)

changes.title: Rig hocks
items: On the ground, four-legged creatures' legs bend where their species' do: a deer's hock high and sharp over an upright cannon, a bear's flat foot, a wolf's wrist, following the creature art instead of one guessed bend for all

changes.title: Rhino
items: A new creature, the rhino, with its own area, the bushveld (close thorn scrub on red earth): a grey hulk with a great horn on its nose that lowers its head and charges. Its legend is an elder with one colossal horn ringed in bronze offerings, a hide in heavy armour folds and old scars, and sleeps sunk in the red earth like a boulder; its gift is Rhino's Charge (much faster on the ground, slower to get going). It lives on a later island, out to the south

changes.title: Prop light shadows
items: Soundsystems and runestones light up the trees round them: trees and scenery near one now cast shadows away from its glow, as they do round a campfire
Clearings round soundsystems and runestones are smaller: the trees come in to about 15 m

changes.title: Polarbear
items: A new creature, the polar bear, with its own area, the pack ice: white floes split by black water, a pressure ridge in the middle, wind-bent firs on the shore. It pounces from out of reach. Its legend has a vast shaggy coat streaming back off it, frost on its muzzle, and sleeps sunk in the ice like a drift of old snow; its gift is Polar bear's Blizzard (💌s fly further and land more easily). It lives on a later island, out to the north

changes.title: Less churn
items: Fewer hitches in the treetops: the game makes much less garbage each frame (the wave pointer, the party pieces, the creatures and the lights), so the browser pauses to collect it less often

changes.title: Ibex
items: A new kind of area for the north-east's mountain island, the crags: lichened rock and glacier ice, rock spires, wind-bent larch and gnarled wild olives, broom, juniper and heather among the stones, and a heap of glacier rubble

The ibex, a new creature for it: a stocky wild goat whose horns grow from nothing on the kid to great knobbled scimitars, that backs off and charges like the ram; its legend is the peaks' oldest ibex, its horns grown vast and knobbled, a long beard, lichen on its flanks and stone beads round its legs, and its gift is Ibex's Sure-footed (quicker starts on foot, and a quicker climb to the treetops)

changes.title: Hydra
items: A new creature, the hydra, with its own area, the drowned wood: a many-headed serpent of the black water, one head as a baby and up to seven when grown, each crested with spines. Its legend sleeps half under the water like a heap of drowned roots, its necks ringed in old bronze and two cut-off necks grown back as two heads each; its gift is Hydra's Many Heads (your 💌s come quicker and land a little more easily). It lives on a far island, out to the south-south-west

changes.title: Growth batch 2
items: Eight more animals grow up instead of just getting bigger: a round, big-eared arctic fox kit, a squirrel and a stoat young with short tails and big heads, a newt whose crest comes in, a salamander whose tail thickens (its legend crowned with fire), a flying squirrel whose membrane spreads (glowing on its legend), a pine marten whose tail gets fluffier, and a Komodo dragon with a long heavy head and a dewlap

changes.title: Frost troll
items: A new kind of area for the frozen north's island, the trollwood: weeping birch hung with frost and dark pines in stands, an iced stream, and snow-capped boulders that might be sleeping trolls

The frost troll, a new creature for it: a hunched, shaggy troll with big round eyes, a rosy bulb of a nose and a white beard, knuckling along on its long arms, slow but hard-hitting; its legend is the oldest troll, half turned to stone from its feet up, beads round its neck, and its gift is Frost troll's Long stride (quicker on foot, and a quicker climb to the treetops)

changes.title: Erg trees
items: The Erg grows thorn trees and the odd baobab among its date palms, and its saltbush now shows

changes.title: Elder kit
items: Legends can show their age and their standing now: a grey muzzle and brows, an ear bitten in some old fight, a tusk or horn broken short, a bronze torc, rings on horns and tusks, earrings, cuffs on their legs, little bells. The ram's horns are ringed, a bell at each tip; the shrine fox has rings in its ears and a bell at its throat

changes.title: Drowned larch
items: The drowned wood's larches look drowned: swollen at the waterline, their crowns dark and dying, hung with weed and moss

changes.title: Crocodile
items: A new creature, the crocodile, with its own area, the mangrove swamp: long, low and toothy, it lies in wait and lunges when you come close. Its legend sleeps in the mud like a log, a ridge of standing stones down its back, and its gift is Crocodile's Snap (your blink comes back quicker). It lives on a later island, out to the south-west

changes.title: Creature torso
items: Four-legged creatures have a frame under their coats now: withers over the shoulders, a pelvis at the rump, a dip between, a deep chest in front of the forelegs, and a neck with a nape and a throat, so the head hangs from the neck instead of being skewered on it

changes.title: Creature spine
items: Animals can have a spine of their own along the back, from a crest to a groove: the big cats and the wolf carry a groove between their back muscles, the stag and elk a shoulder line, the boar a bristled crest

changes.title: Creature legs
items: Four-legged creatures have real legs now: an elbow and a wrist in front, a stifle and a hock behind, each kind standing its own way (deer and boar up on slim cannons and hooves, cats and dogs on their toes, bears and badgers flat-footed, newts sprawling), with paws and hooves in place of balls

changes.title: Creature heads
items: Four-legged creatures' faces have bones now: a brow over the eyes, cheeks, a lower jaw with a mouth, and whiskers on the ones that have them, so a lynx reads as a cat and a bear as a bear from the front

changes.title: Creature growth
items: Eight animals grow up instead of just growing: the lynx, cheetah, cat, boar, raccoon, red panda, polar bear and meerkat are slight and long-legged when young and deep in the chest as adults

changes.title: Creature girth
items: Animals are no longer sausages: a body can have a deep, wide chest and a slim waist (its width and depth set apart along its length). The big cats, the wolf, fox and fennec, and the stag, roe and elk have theirs

changes.title: Birds snake
items: Herons grow their plumes as they age, and the heron legend is now a tall elder carrying a softly glowing paper lantern in its bill
Baby ravens are downy fledglings with stubby tails
Baby snakes have bigger heads, and their markings come in as they grow

changes.title: Area edges toggle
items: The glowing dotted edges round the party's areas are gone (a pause-page switch brings them back)

changes.title: Arctic fox
items: A new kind of area for the cold north's island, the snowfield: deep snow under snow-laden firs and dwarf birch, and a ring of old stones half buried in a drift

The arctic fox, a new creature for it: a small white fox with a huge brush that leaps on you like a fox mousing in the snow; its legend is the oldest of the white foxes, shaggy and frost-muzzled, with one vast tufted brush and stone beads round its legs, and its gift is Arctic fox's Snow pounce (a longer blink, and quicker starts on foot)

changes.title: Sound budget
items: The sound cuts out less: the singer's effects use half the work they did, the costliest go first if the sound struggles, and only so many sound effects play at once (the nearest and most important)
Pause page: a slider for how many sound effects play at once

changes.title: Rune pull any side
items: A happy creature near you brings its sigil to your feet from any side, walking round you and your animals

changes.title: Meerkat
items: A new animal for the badlands: the meerkat, scurrying about its red-rock warren under twisted junipers and sitting up as a lookout when it stops
Its legend's boon, Lookout: your 💌s reach further

changes.title: Home forest mammals
items: Home is now all green woods and mostly furry friends: a fox in the old oaks, a hare in the bluebell glade, a mole in the fern forest, a badger in the wispy forest, a stoat in the alder forest, a squirrel in the twiggy forest and a pine marten in the old pinewood
The owl, toad and beetle now live further out, on the islands
The owl now nests at the stone shrine, glowworms light the meadow, the boar roots in the grassland, woodlice live on the moor, the snake basks on Norway's slate and the wolf prowls the lost garden

changes.title: Hologram bend
items: The soundsystems' sky sigils no longer show through the ground past the horizon

changes.title: Happy rune south
items: A happy creature carries its sigil a little to the south of it, the same distance a parked creature rests from its placed sigil; pick it up there
A happy creature's rune shows through grass, bushes and trees, as a placed sigil does

changes.title: Beach decor half
items: Half as many shells, pebbles, seaweed and footprint trails on the beach

changes.title: Temple variants
items: The temple ruins come in many more shapes, different on every island: a round temple, a long colonnade, a temple on its podium, a fallen pediment, a portico half buried in a mound, an overgrown theatre
Small classical ruins scatter more widely: a few columns, a lone column, a doorway, an altar on its steps

changes.title: Swoop bottom
items: Swooping ravens, owls and bats linger 4 s at the bottom of each dive (was 2, 2 and 1), so you have time to invite them

changes.title: Scenery cuts
items: The island's scenery is cut back: no sports grounds (the old playground stays), no set pieces, no scattered rocks or odd trees, no railway wagons, signals, bridges, stairs or signposts
Twice as many ruins, and a ruined Greek temple or a stand of classical ruins on most islands
Fewer moonlit ponds, and the shells and starfish on the beach are twice the size

changes.title: Relic bottles
items: Relic bottles are a third the size they were, their sigil closer in

changes.title: No canopy rings
items: The faint rings of moonlight on the treetops are gone

changes.title: Dodge distance
items: The dodge (blink) goes 50% further: 15 m, up from 10

changes.title: Bottle glow
items: A relic bottle's glow on the ground is smaller, to suit the smaller bottle

changes.title: Baby gap
items: Babies following you walk 5 m apart, up from 1.6 m

changes.title: Sigil floor
items: The grass round a placed sigil is trampled short instead of gone, so there's no dark patch behind it

changes.title: Slashes bigger
items: Her claw slashes are twice as big and glow bright red like the berries, easy to read from the ground and the treetops

changes.title: Sigil holograms
items: Every soundsystem now projects its area's animal sigil into the sky as a flickering hologram over the treetops, in place of its lasers; it glitches when the soundsystem is hurt and folds away when it falls

changes.title: Four hits
items: She now takes four hits to go down: three claw slashes, then the knockdown
Her claw slashes are a deeper, solid red, with a matching glow
Your leash's sigils no longer flicker when you're hurt

changes.title: Wisps
items: Faint will-o'-the-wisps drift slowly between the trees of the wild forest, fading in and out; none where the party is, and fewer the nearer you get to it

changes.title: Watching trees
items: The trees watch you: leafy tips close to you lean a little your way, a moment behind you

changes.title: Sprite quirks
items: Birds, bugs and the little creatures have idle habits too: owls look behind them, ravens hop, hedgehogs and snails puff up, moths and beetles shiver
From the treetops every creature shows its idle habit

changes.title: Sigil spill
items: Sigils you put down cast their colour on the ground and anyone near them
The sigil you carry tints you in its colour

changes.title: Sigil nope
items: Trying to put a sigil down too close to another now gives a soft "uh-uh" sound

changes.title: Sigil freeze
items: A freeze the first time a sigil showed (the leash's stack, a placed rune, a quest bubble) is gone: the game no longer reads that picture back from the graphics card mid-frame.

changes.title: Scale one
items: The home speakers' runestones are crisp pixel art, and party decorations pop in without blurring

changes.title: Making of
items: The Making Of: a little website about how the game was built, at /making-of/ beside the game

changes.title: Light rings
items: Seen from the treetops, faint rings of moonlight shimmer on the crowns here and there, slowly breathing outward

changes.title: Ley curvature
items: The ley line never kinks: it sweeps through each runestone in one smooth curve and never turns tighter than 25 m (leyLines.minRadius); where the next stone lies back the way it came, it loops round the stone instead of doubling back in a hairpin

changes.title: Ley cheaper
items: The ley line costs about a third less work when a run begins: it finds its low ground at half as many points, and follows much the same path.

changes.title: Level gap
items: Grown-up creatures are now far stronger than young ones (about three and a half times), so evolving your animals to adult really pays, and the wild adults far from home hit harder
Young creatures are a little gentler, and young and adults take fewer 💌s to win over (7 and 14, from 9 and 18)
Evolving now costs 3 berries to young and 8 to adult (it was 4 and 4)
Add ?tuning=pre-overnight to the link to play the balance as it was before tonight

changes.title: Ground texture cap
items: On computers whose graphics card can't hold a very large texture, the forest floor now shows each area's own ground (moss, paths, ponds) instead of one plain earth everywhere, and the game uses far less memory

changes.title: Friendly area
items: Bringing a legend what it dreams of now makes its whole area friendly at once: the creatures already living there stop attacking her (any mid-fight calm down and drop their sieges), not only the ones grown there afterwards

changes.title: Eerie trees
items: Five eerie old trees now stand somewhere in every forest: a bleached dead tree, a hunched gnarled one, a fat hollow trunk, a dead tree cleft in two, and one bowed right over into an arch

changes.title: Circle baby naps
items: The little one in a legend's circle now spends most of its time curled up asleep, stirring now and then; it wakes when you come to its circle

changes.title: Big four shapes
items: Wolves stand taller and leaner on long legs, the adults with a shaggy mane
Badgers are low, wide and flat, on short thick legs
Boars carry a big shoulder hump and a heavy front end
Bears are massive, with a high shoulder hump and pillar legs

changes.title: Bark faces
items: A tree or two in each wild area has a face half-seen in its bark, if you look closely

changes.title: Amphibian shapes
items: Newts carry a tall jagged crest along their backs
Salamanders sprawl low and stocky on short thick legs

changes.title: Wild naps
items: Wild creatures sometimes nap while idling: they wake (with a stretch) when you land in their area, and sleep on while you fly over in the treetops or watch from the next area

changes.title: Stars
items: The stars show again through the soft blur at the top of the screen; how much the sky blurs is a slider in the decisions panel
The moon reads clearly through the blur at every phase, and a thin crescent is one unbroken sliver

changes.title: Stall log
items: The debug overlay (~) notes every freeze of a tenth of a second or more and what it was busy with, and the playtest log (L) keeps them

changes.title: Spooky light
items: The forest is a spooky dark wood now: cold blue-green shadows, a violet fog that comes in close round the trees, thicker ground mist, and the party's lights and your glow are the warm ones in the dark
Add ?light=plain to the link to see the old lighting

changes.title: Spiral route
items: The ley line now spirals out from home: the party spreads steadily outward, ring by ring, round every side of home in turn, with now and then a little lobe and a few crossings (?route=varied for the old route)

changes.title: Soft reveal
items: Walking through thick forest, the treetops around the witch fade away softly, tree by tree, instead of in rings

changes.title: Soft cutout
items: The see-through hole in the canopy round her fades out softly over a wide band, its edge wandering, instead of a hard ring of whole crowns; trunk tops fade out smoothly where their crowns are hidden

changes.title: Smoother witch
items: The witch no longer shivers a pixel either way as she flies: she holds still while the forest glides under her
💌s and the animals' shots glide smoothly on fast screens (120 Hz and up) instead of moving every other frame

changes.title: Smooth legs
items: Creatures' legs read as smooth limbs, not strings of balls: a full thigh tapering to the knee, and hind legs that bend back at the hock

changes.title: Siege far
items: A siege that starts while you are far away now marches on its soundsystem at once, instead of waiting for you to come near

changes.title: Shadow audit
items: Sleeping legends lie over their own shadows: the fox, elk and beaver were drawn metres to one side of where they lie
Sleeping animals sit exactly on the ground, and the witch stands on the ground itself when she lands on a slope
Party animals keep their party gear on when they fall asleep

changes.title: Rules types
items: Housekeeping: the rules' combat and invite events and the legend-buff tuning helpers are typed more tightly (no change to play).

changes.title: Relic placement
items: Every map now has one of each of the six relics: one waiting near the edge of home, the rest scattered across the forest, never close together
Each relic has its golden sigil lying on the ground just in front of it: stand on it and press E to pick the relic up

changes.title: Rebuild slices
items: Smoother flying over the forest: the scenery around you is rebuilt a little each frame instead of all at once

changes.title: Rebuild fps
items: On a slow machine the scenery is rebuilt in one go again, so trees no longer pop in when the frame rate is low

changes.title: Quests while sleeping
items: A sleeping legend's quest no longer closes when its area's soundsystem switches on: bring it the creature it dreams of any time it's asleep, and its buff is yours

changes.title: Pixel lines
items: Projectiles, sparks, the leash's beads and the attack rings are drawn in chunky art pixels now, with their glow still soft round them
The ley line is much easier to see: a bright pixel line with a soft glow, on every ground and from the treetops; its pulse and the boot ring are pixels too
The ley line shows along its whole length, from the treehouse to its tip, as bright all the way: through the trees, over the hills, and on into every stone
Invitations are pixel art now as they spin, orbit, fall and rest, their pixels lined up with everything else's

changes.title: Party light
items: Every party is a warm glow in the dark wood now: the soundsystems light their clearings amber, pink and gold, and more of the lanterns and campfires cast wider pools of light

changes.title: Pages concurrency
items: Playable links: several pull requests deploying at once no longer knock each other's preview out; each retries until its own folder is published.

changes.title: No walking away
items: Charging and leaping creatures can no longer be escaped by just walking away: charges run on until they catch you and leaps land where you're going
A well-timed blink, sideways or straight through a charge, gets you clear, and the charger stands winded for a moment: the time to land your 💌s

changes.title: No road decor
items: Broken bits of road and tarmac no longer turn up scattered in the forest as clutter; the real roads and paths are unchanged

changes.title: No guards
items: Behind the scenes: the old guards (a quest-done area's creatures defending it) are gone from the code; nothing changes in play

changes.title: Moon rim
items: The witch and every creature catch a thin edge of moonlight on their far side, so they stand out of the dark wood; the witch's own glow lights her too, and each place keeps more of its own colour at night

changes.title: Moon r3
items: The night wood is blue-green again, not lavender: the moonlight on the treetops and open ground is paler
Dark crowns and rock spires no longer show a grid of bright dots in the moonlight; faded tree trunks fade in soft clusters
In the bold and ref art styles the witch now stands out in her own light
A partied area's ground glows warm amber again; its neon colour stays on the bulbs and the soundsystem

changes.title: Moon fill
items: The dark wood is easier to read: moonlight catches the treetops and open ground, so you can see the forest's shape from above
Berries glow as small bright red dots instead of big blurry red lights
The ley line is a softer amber guide, no longer the brightest thing on the ground
The moonlit edge on the witch and the creatures now shows in the bold and ref art styles too

changes.title: Leylines variety
items: Ley line routes vary from map to map (Ed: "mix in back-and-forth sweeps and lobes so maps aren't all spirals"): petals round home, then sweeps, lobes or combs, still with no crossings (at most four allowed, 12 waves apart, none in the first 12).

changes.title: Leylines uncrossed
items: The ley line now runs through every wave's runestone the whole time, brightest from the last one reached, and never crosses itself (Ed: "I thought the idea was to have no crossings?"): the waves follow the noisy picker's order, untangled, so every map's route still differs. ?picker=noisy for the old order.

changes.title: Ley pulse
items: A pulse of light travels along the ley line toward the next soundsystem, the line glowing brighter as the next wave nears, and arrives just as the wave does
While home's speakers boot up there's no ley line; when the first wave's countdown starts, the line grows out from the treehouse, reaching the third runestone as the wave lands

changes.title: Ley front
items: The front of the ley line is a small pixel spark that pulses on the beat, with a soft little light and embers flying off as it writes the line; it flares as it reaches a stone, and you can spot it from the treetops
Ahead of the pulse the ley line is a faint dashed sketch; behind it, lit and glowing: you can see the pulse light it up as it goes
The ley line leaves the speaker ring from the ring itself, one path from the treehouse out into the forest, and shows the way out while home boots up
No more ley line showing through hills far off, and no more blown-out glare at its front

changes.title: Ley depart
items: The ley line no longer crosses the dancefloor: it runs round the speakers from the treehouse, off to the right, and loops round to the first runestone

changes.title: Legends in half
items: Legends now sleep in only about half the areas, spread across the map; the rest have no legend, clearing or quest

changes.title: Legend sleep
items: Legends look for their own kind every 5 seconds, each on its own beat; an angry legend calms back to sleep once one of its kind is back in its area; and a legend going back to sleep away from where it lay walks home first and lies down where it spawned (Ed).

changes.title: Legend siege
items: A wave no longer marks the area's sleeping legend as an enraged besieger: legends turn angry only by their own rules

changes.title: Legend layers
items: An angry legend now bombards your soundsystems when you're out of its reach, though it always goes for you first
Legend buffs from quests and relics can be made stronger, and happy legends can reach further (sliders on the decisions panel)
A trial switch on the decisions panel: a legend that turns angry stamps on its own area's soundsystem

changes.title: Legend back trees
items: The bear, elk and beaver legends grow real little trees on their backs: oaks, pines and willows, bigger and lit for the night

changes.title: Invites linger
items: 💌s now spin flat like a frisbee as they fly
💌s that miss now lie flat on the ground for a couple of seconds before they fade away

changes.title: Horizon lead
items: Creatures far ahead over the treetops no longer pop into view at the horizon

changes.title: Growth
items: The wild areas grow half as fast (a new creature every other wave), so a well-defended party now lasts much longer than one left alone

changes.title: Ground copy
items: Fewer hitches flying over new ground: each new patch of ground is copied straight in, instead of through the graphics card's framebuffers

changes.title: Grass cell
items: Far from the middle of the map, the grass and ferns round her grow where she stands again (they were fetched up to 18 m off)

changes.title: Grace
items: After a hit you get half a second's grace: a pack biting at once now costs you one hit, not all three

changes.title: Floor sigil
items: The carving on each legend circle's floor is now the legend's own sigil, rune bands, medallions and all, half lost under the moss

changes.title: Far dreams
items: A sleeping legend can still dream of a creature from anywhere, but never from the far side of the map
Quests whose creature lives far away now give a stronger buff, up to half again as strong

changes.title: Dash to cursor
items: Your dodge now goes towards the mouse cursor (a little diamond shows where you'd land); with the cursor right on the witch, it goes the way she's facing

changes.title: Creator sliders
items: The broom has a thickness slider beside its length, for every kind of broom (a skinny stick to a fat missile or a tub of a canoe), saved with her and drawn in flight and on the party witches

Every slider in the character creator now changes her for every option: the hat's lean works on every hat, the little hat's height, brim and band work, the traffic cone's base and stripes and the crown's and mushroom's glow follow the brim and band sliders; and sliders that can't apply are greyed out (no hat's height, a beanie's brim, a canoe's bend, a drone's bristles, no cloak's length)

changes.title: Controls space wheel
items: Controls: Space rises and lands, E puts a sigil down, Q cycles your sigils (on the ground too), and the mouse wheel zooms

changes.title: Circle from stone
items: A sleeping legend's circle now lies well away from its area's runestone, never beside the soundsystem's party

changes.title: Charges
items: Charging animals (boars, elk, stags, rams, hedgehogs, woodlice) now run much further, carrying their momentum past you in wide arcs before they come round again
A charging animal hurts anyone it touches on its way, not only at the end; a lynx's pounce carries on through you
Fights with chargers and lynxes are much more dangerous: keep moving and blink across their lane
A wild animal knocked down in a fight now lies stunned for 20 seconds before it runs off, plenty of time to win it over with 💌s
Wild animals now chase you up to 30 m outside their area, then give up and trot back home instead of waiting at the edge

changes.title: Bot game
items: Bot game: a button on the start screen to watch the skilled bot play a whole run (or ?bot=skilled, ?bot=crude); its tag says what she's doing, 1×/2×/4× speeds it up, Esc comes back

changes.title: Bot game buffs
items: In the bot game the skilled witch now does a few legend quests, brings relics to the legends by the coming waves, and leads her young creatures to berries

changes.title: Boot ring
items: The game now starts when you cast the party spell: a ley line runs round the dancefloor's ring of runestones, clockwise from the top, and its pulse turns each stone into a speaker; when the last one turns, the first wave's countdown begins

changes.title: Bend hides
items: Nothing on the ground shows through the curve of the world any more: invitations, hearts, chat bubbles and the angry and dazed marks past the horizon are hidden by the earth

changes.title: Attack alarm
items: A soundsystem (or the home ring's speakers) under attack off screen shows a 🔇 at the screen's edge pointing to it, drawn in pixels like the 🎶 pointer: its ring is the soundsystem's health, draining as it's hit, the cue shakes at each blow, it says how far, and it flashes and fades if the soundsystem falls; one per soundsystem, up to three, on the ground and from the treetops (?debug=attack to see it)
The edge pointers' distances are one crisp pixel label each: pointers that would sit on one another are moved apart along the edge, and each label sits clear of its ring

changes.title: Area recipes
items: Behind the scenes: a new kind of area can now be added as a recipe of data alone, the first step towards many more areas

changes.title: Area moods
items: Each kind of place has its own mood in the dark: misty teal over the bogs and ponds, violet-grey in the dead and ancient woods, pale mist on the open moor, near-black under the pines; it shifts gently as you fly from one to the next

changes.title: Aim reticle
items: A small ring follows the mouse: pink within a 💌's reach, broken beyond it, and a blue arc fills round it while your dodge recharges
Dodging a moment too early still works: the dodge goes as soon as it's ready

changes.title: Affection meter
items: The pink heart meter over a creature you are inviting shows again as your 💌s land, and the fill tick sounds as it rises

changes.title: Witch hats
items: New hats for the witches: none at all, a top hat, cowboy hat, straw conical hat, deely boppers, party hat, musketeer's plumed hat, a starry wizard's hat, a bobble beanie, a crown, a mushroom cap and a traffic cone
Scarves from short to trailing, bags of any size, and backpacks; hats, cloaks and brooms can go much further

changes.title: Wasd mouse controls
items: New controls: WASD to fly (arrows still work), the mouse to aim, left click throws 💌s
Right click dodges (Space too), Q rises or lands, E puts down a sigil or cycles them, R casts the speed spell
No more browser menu when you right click the game

changes.title: Travel posse
items: Your animals keep out of trouble on long trips: far from you on the ground (or from their sigil) they travel quietly along the edges between areas, a little faster, and wild animals leave them be
Close to you on the ground, or near their sigil, they're your posse again and fight as before; they don't drop out mid-fight
While an animal travels, its leash becomes its route: a dotted line on the ground from it to you or its sigil, snaking along the area borders (easy to see from the treetops)
Only your posse eats berries: travellers don't stop for them

changes.title: Tilt sky
items: The miniature blur now covers the night sky too, so over the treetops the stars and moon soften with the edges of the picture instead of staying sharp

changes.title: A full-screen start screen
items: The start screen fills the window with big, easy-to-read text over the dimmed forest
"New in" this version lists each change with its own heading and bullets, dated, with the two versions before it underneath
"Coming up" lists the work in progress, straight from what the builders have open, so it's always current
On a phone, drag to scroll the text; a tap still starts

changes.title: Species fight
items: Every animal now fights its own way: rams back off and ram, stags charge in pairs, elk swing wide, bears swipe hard and short, badgers dig in, beavers block with their tails, lynxes pounce, foxes and martens go round to your back, snakes strike from hiding, moths flock to light, hedgehogs and woodlice roll up, snails leave slowing slime, glow-worms flash to slow you, and stoats, otters, squirrels and dormice dart and weave

Each new move shows clearly: glistening slime, a burst of glow-worm light, a ring of thrown-up earth round a dug-in badger, a beaver's raised tail and the glint of a blocked shot, spikes whirling round a rolling hedgehog
Try each new move in the arena: ?arena=ram, pair, wide, swipe, dig, block, flank, packflank, pounce, strike, moth, roll, woodlouse, slime, flash, weave, otter, squirrel, dart

changes.title: Pixel wind
items: Leaves now sway in clumps, each bunch moving a whole step at a time, instead of smearing

changes.title: Picnics
items: Home has picnics: blankets in gingham, stripes and tartan with baskets, cups, cakes and fruit on them, and picnic tables with benches or chairs round them
Taller balloons: single balloons and bunches high on long strings, bobbing in the breeze

changes.title: Momentum and spacing
items: Charging boars have weight: they lower their head, build up speed, thunder on past you, then skid round in a wide arc before coming again
Creatures in a fight speed up, slow down and turn smoothly, without jerking or flickering left and right; a momentum knob joins fight scale and speed in the debug panel (, and .)
Wild creatures give up the chase soon after you leave their area (about 10 m past its edge) and head back home
Animals don't bunch up any more: walking, following you, marching or fighting, each keeps some room round it, more for big ones (a bear keeps much more space than a dormouse)

changes.title: Legends redesign
items: Legends sleep on through the party: a soundsystem no longer wakes them
Bring a sleeping legend the creature it dreams of before its area's soundsystem switches on, and its buff is yours for good; it sleeps on

Take every one of a legend's own kind out of its area and it grows restless, its dream turning to a nightmare; bring one back to calm it, or after a minute it wakes angry and lobs or beams at you and your posse from far off (never at soundsystems)

Giant party relics lie half buried about the forest: pick one up (it joins your stack, sigil button) and put it down by a sleeping legend to make it happy: its buff is yours, and it shoots the enraged from afar to defend you
A legend worn down goes back to sleep, and a buff you've earned from it is never taken away

changes.title: Legend charge
items: Charging legends (boar, elk, stag, ram, hedgehog, woodlouse) charge across the map: head down with their lane shown on the ground, then a heavy run that curves after you, trampling everything in the way and knocking you aside, then a wide braking arc and the long walk home before they can charge again
Legends fight only with their long-range attacks for now

changes.title: Legend buffs
items: Legend buffs redesigned: 30 different buffs, each changing only your 💌s (fans, rings, echoes, homing, piercing, ricochets, splitting, boomerangs, lantern trails, caches, orbiting 💌s...) or how you move (blink charges, longer blinks, speed after a blink...)
A 💌 is never stronger: buffs give more of them or change how they fly, and each animal still takes at most one every half second
Firing slows you a little on the ground (Ram's Steady takes that away)

changes.title: Knockback
items: A blow now throws you back and staggers you for a moment (you wobble, with stars round your hat, and can't move, blink or throw 💌s): a bite or a shot nudges you a couple of metres, a heavy blow further, and a charging boar or stag sends you flying about 12 m

A throw carries you straight through trees and bushes (you never end up inside one), a blink still dodges everything, and after a stagger you can't be staggered again for a second, so a pack can't keep you dazed
?knock=0 in the link turns the knockback off

changes.title: Invites
items: Invite with 💌s instead of chatting: on the ground, click (or hold 1) to throw a burst of spinning 💌s at the cursor; on a gamepad, aim with the right stick and throw with a trigger; on touch, the 💌 button throws them the way you're going
Each 💌 that lands fills a little meter of hearts over the creature (babies need a few, adults many); it drains slowly if you stop; full, the creature joins your party
A creature can only take one 💌's worth of affection every half second: a burst helps you invite a crowd, not one creature faster (the extra letters still land with a little ✨)
You call out with an emoji every time you throw, and the creature you hit answers, warming up as its meter fills
A creature's reply bubble is sized by its level: babies' smallest, legends' largest (yours stays the same)
Enraged creatures and legends block 💌s (they answer 😠); your own party animals let them through

Enraged creatures are tinted a soft red (easy to pick out, even from the treetops), wear angry brows over their red eyes and have a 💢 popping beside their heads; dazed ones see stars; happy ones wear party clothes without the glowing collar (that's for your party), and dance where there's a soundsystem; legends never dress up
Party animals, happy ones and your own, twinkle with a few little sparkles, so you can spot them in a crowd

changes.title: Invite lob
items: Your 💌 invites now go one envelope at a time, tumbling end over end in a gentle lob that lands with a puff
They fly half as far again and a fifth faster; each creature needs a few more of them, so winning one over takes about as long as before

changes.title: Glow near
items: The witch's light is brighter right around her and falls away to dark much closer, so the forest round her has more depth

changes.title: Gentle start
items: A gentler start: every wild area begins with just a baby and a young one, so you can invite one and still leave its legend a creature of its own kind
The home speakers now take five minutes to boot up, counted from when you get up from the decks: no waves and no new creatures till then, and a note by the wave bar tells you when they're up

changes.title: Freeze
items: Esc (or Start on a gamepad, or the ❚❚ button by the volume) pauses everything, music too, as a still picture for screenshots; a panel shows the version, seed, game time, where you are, the area and the camera, with a link to copy; while paused, . steps one frame and Shift+. ten; Esc again carries on

changes.title: Frames
items: The view glides instead of stepping a whole art pixel at a time when you move (add ?subpixel=0 to the link to compare with before)
The debug panel (~) shows what the frames really are: the frame time's spread, the slowest frames, and how long the game's own work and the GPU take each frame (where the browser can time it)

changes.title: Creature states
items: Animals now have four moods. Wild: as they were. Happy: invited, they stay in their own area, defend it against sieges and dance at its soundsystem. Leashed: invited a second time, they're yours for good. Enraged: offended by a new soundsystem in their area, they besiege the nearest one
Wild and happy animals leave each other alone, and so do wild and enraged; your leashed animals take on the wild and the enraged; the enraged go for the happy; still nobody fights its own kind
Nobody is killed: a knocked-down wild animal lies dazed for a while (you can still invite it), then runs off home; any other knocked down just runs off
Knocked down yourself, your carried sigils are put down where your animals stand, so they stay yours as a parked group
Until the 💌 invites arrive, chatting works the same way: one chat makes an animal happy, a second one leashes it

changes.title: Creature faces
items: Creatures pull faces: an enraged one glares with its brows down, a party animal (or a friendly area's creature) beams with its eyes closed in smiling arcs, and a stunned one looks dazed with crossed-out or odd eyes
The faces are part of each creature, not marks over its head, and each family has its own: feathery brows on birds and bats, brow ridges on snakes and beetles

changes.title: Creator
items: Make your own witch while the forest grows: the game opens in her treehouse room (a mirror, and a banner: PARTY TONIGHT) and you dress her up: hat (shape, height, lean, brim), hair, top and cloak, broom, accessories and the colour of every part, with Randomise and Classic buttons
Start shows how far the forest has grown; press it early and she's "getting ready" until it's done, then straight into play
She's remembered on this browser for next time
Every look keeps her a witch: always a pointed hat with its glowing band, and a broom

changes.title: Creator 2
items: Character creator: the sliders go much further, for huge hats, tiny brims, giant brooms
Every colour has a rainbow picker: 256 hues, a shade and a grey strip
New: no hat, a hat picker, scarf length, bag size and backpack size (the new hats and bags are still being drawn)
🌀 Wild: a witch with everything anywhere

changes.title: Blink
items: The dodge (W) is now a blink: she vanishes and reappears 10 m on the way she's going (or facing, if she's still), with a puff of motes where she left, a burst where she lands and a faint streak between
She can't be hit in the instant she's gone, and she never lands inside a tree, a rock, a soundsystem or the treehouse: the blink stops short at the last clear spot

changes.title: Berry cost
items: Evolving now costs 2 berries then 2 (was 1 then 3): still 4 from baby to adult, each berry buying the same strength. Berry patches are bigger, so there are more berries about

changes.title: Area flora
items: Every kind of wood now grows its own mix of three to six kinds of tree, in its own shades
Ten new trees: wild cherry in blossom, crab apple, elder, aspen, silvery whitebeam, field elm and flat-tiered cedar

Three magical ones, rarely and only where magic suits: glowing mushroom trees in the hazel rings, crystal-leaf trees by the cave mouth, and vine-hung trees with glowing buds in the old garden and the holly thicket

changes.title: Stiltwalkers potion
items: Stiltwalkers replaces Tall Tales: familiar animal bodies ride high on long legs that taper to tiny feet.

changes.title: Save slots
items: Keep separate progress and settings in save slots, and switch or start a fresh save from Settings → Saves.
Saved nights can continue after a game update when their save format is compatible.
